name: Teen Mom OG
description: In 16 and Pregnant, they were moms-to-be. Now, follow Farrah, Maci, Amber, and Catelynn as they face the challenges of motherhood. Each episode interweaves these stories revealing the wide variety of challenges young mothers can face: marriage, relationships, family support, adoption, finances, graduating high school, starting college, getting a job, and the daunting and exciting step of moving out to create their own families.

videos.title: Catching Up with 16 and Pregnant: The Girls of Teen Mom
videos.overview: Before Maci, Farrah, Amber and Catelynn return as teenage mothers, the audience is presented with a look at the most significant moments from 16 and Pregnant.

videos.title: Check Up with Dr. Drew
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts the cast of Teen Mom on-stage in front of a live studio audience. Maci, Farrah, Catelynn and Amber reflect on the struggles of their first year of motherhood, and reveal what's happened since.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts a look at the exclusive moments we never saw with Farrah, Maci, Catelynn and Amber from the first season of Teen Mom.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: This episode shows all the unseen clips of episodes that were not aired during season two, and is hosted once again by Dr. Drew Pinsky.

videos.title: Check Up With Dr. Drew
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts the cast of 'Teen Mom' on-stage in front of a live studio audience. Maci, Farrah, Catelynn and Amber reflect on the second season, and reveal what's happened since.

videos.title: Baby Talk
videos.overview: A special 30 minute episode all about the babies. The cast sit together to watch parts not shown in the second season. They include Top 3 cutest moments, Teen MOMents, and other challenging things the moms went through.

videos.title: Teen Dads
videos.overview: Hosted by Dr. Drew, for the first time the dads of 'Teen Mom' and 'Teen Mom 2' come together to discuss the ups and downs, the challenges, the hilarious moments, and the biggest mistakes they've made since becoming young fathers.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts the four teen moms in front of a live studio audience. In part one of the finale special, Farrah and Amber reflect on the past year of motherhood - the struggles, triumphs, legal battles, and family strife that we saw them face in Season 3, and everything that has happened since.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
videos.overview: In the dramatic conclusion of the finale, Catelynn and Maci discuss the new milestones, custody battles, school struggles, and family problems that we saw them face in Season 3, and Ryan and Kyle share the stage for the first time.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts an exclusive look at never-before-seen laughs, struggles and other drama from Season 3 with Farrah, Maci, Catelynn, and Amber.

videos.title: Catching Up With the Girls of Teen Mom
videos.overview: A look back at Amber, Catelynn, Farrah, and Amber's stories from the beginning of 16 & Pregnant, through the triumphs and challenges, and most emotional moments of the first three seasons of Teen Mom.

videos.title: Series Finale Special: Check Up With Dr. Drew Part 1
videos.overview: Dr. Drew sits down with Catelynn and Farrah to discuss the emotional final season and hear updates on the lives of the original Teen Moms.

videos.title: Series Finale Special: Check Up With Dr. Drew Part 2
videos.overview: Dr. Drew sits down with Maci and Gary to discuss the emotional final season and hear updates on the lives of the original Teen Moms.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Dr. Drew hosts a look at the exclusive moments we never saw with Farrah, Maci, Catelynn and Amber from the final season of Teen Mom.

videos.title: Teen Mom Farewell Special
videos.overview: The original Teen Moms look back, reflect and say goodbye as their stories come to an end.

videos.title: Ask the Moms
videos.overview: In this half hour special, Teen Mom fans finally get a chance to ask Maci, Farrah, Amber, and Catelynn (and the major players in their lives) all the questions they've been dying to know. After four amazing seasons, there's still lots we don't know and now people across the country will get a chance to ask the mom's and the dad's directly... and get the inside scoop.

videos.title: Being Farrah
videos.overview: Since appearing on Teen Mom, Farrah shocked the world with a sex tape and multiple plastic surgeries. Farrah is forced to confront those choices head on when her mom Debra comes to visit her and her daughter, Sophia.

videos.title: Being Catelynn
videos.overview: It’s been two years since Teen Mom wrapped and Catelynn continues to struggle with the reality of having chosen adoption for her daughter Carly and now questions whether her and Tyler will ever get married.

videos.title: Being Amber
videos.overview: Two years ago, Amber went from being the bad girl of Teen Mom, to a prison inmate. After being locked up for a year and a half, we see Amber reconnect with her daughter, deal with her past, and cope with the outside world

videos.title: Catch Up Special
videos.overview: Catch up with original girls who started it all and relive Catelynn, Maci, and Amber’s journeys as they navigate being 16 and pregnant to the Teen Mom's they are today.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (1)
videos.overview: Dr. Drew sits down with the cast of Teen Mom OG in front of a studio audience, and chats with Maci about her decision to pull Bentley off the show. Amber and Matt discuss their age difference.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (2)
videos.overview: Catelynn has an adorable surprise for Teresa, and Farrah discusses all of the drama that surrounded her return to the show. The four moms finally get serious and unpack the conflict between them.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Dr. Drew and the girls take a look at never-before-seen footage and share the behind-the-scenes secrets from Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (1)
videos.overview: The girls and families reunite with Dr. Drew. In this part one, Maci and Farrah dig deeper into their journey, exploring Maci's relationship with Ryan and Farrah's romance with Simon and fiery final moment.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (2)
videos.overview: Catelynn breaks down over her depression and Tyler and Butch open up about their individual childhoods. Amber and Matt confront Gary over exposing Matt’s numerous child support cases.

videos.title: Catch Up Special
videos.overview: Look back at the past 7 years of the original Teen Moms, from new loves and cute kids to break-ups and mama drama, as well as exclusive sneak peeks at the upcoming 6th season.

videos.title: Ask the Moms (vol.2)
videos.overview: Hosted by Nessa, a fun-filled show in which Maci, Amber, and Catelynn engage with fans to answer all the questions they've been burning to ask.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (1)
videos.overview: Dr. Drew talks to Catelynn about her battle with depression and anxiety, and when Amber gets upset over her battles with Farrah and Gary, she threatens to quit the show.

videos.title: 100 Things About Teen Mom OG
videos.overview: The cast of Teen Mom OG lists 100 fun facts about the hit MTV series.

videos.title: Check-Up with Dr. Drew (2)
videos.overview: Dr. Drew discusses Maci's marriage and new baby, Amber storms the stage when Farrah insults Matt, and the moms band together to do something Dr. Drew never expected.

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler decide to connect with their fans and help them find the missing people in their lives.

videos.title: Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Maci, Catelynn, and Amber join Nessa to react to a collection of hilarious and touching never-before-seen clips from "Teen Mom OG."

videos.title: Being The Edwards
videos.overview: Larry and Jen have helped Ryan care for his son Bentley for 8 years, but a fight between Ryan and Larry nearly broke their family apart; the Edwards family is determined to build a strong foundation of support and understanding.

videos.title: Being Debra
videos.overview: Newly engaged Debra is head over heels in love with fiancé David, but her relationship with daughter Farrah is still rocky. Debra starts her own record label and comes up with a plan to unite her family through song.

videos.title: Check Up with Dr. Drew (1)
videos.overview: Amber lashes out about her troubled relationship with Matt and Maci faces some harsh truths about Matt's drug use.

videos.title: Check Up with Dr. Drew (2)
videos.overview: Farrah explains her dislike for her mom's fiance, and Catelynn opens up about how she and Tyler have dealt with Butch's relapse.

videos.title: Ask the Moms
videos.overview: Catelynn, Maci, and Amber get real - and real emotional - when answering fan questions about the show and their lives off-screen.

videos.title: Teen Mom Aftershow Live for Episode #620
videos.overview: A focus on fashion, with a runway show featuring Amber and Maci's clothing lines and Farrah gives two fans a Mommy Makeover!

videos.title: Being Simon
videos.overview: Farrah's ex-boyfriend, Simon, is busy juggling his real estate career, friends, and nightlife. But now he wants to partner up with Farrah and flip houses. After a trip to the bay area, Farrah gets to know Simon's Indian culture and spark fly..again.

videos.title: That's a Wrap 2017
videos.overview: You're invited to the party of the year with the casts of Teen Mom OG and Teen Mom 2! Join them in a swanky LA loft for a night of games, gossip, and fun as they celebrate 2017 and look ahead to 2018.

videos.title: Being Gary
videos.overview: To celebrate Leah’s 9th birthday, Gary plans a trip to Florida with his family and hopes to fix his difficult relationship with his mom, Carol. Meanwhile, his parents recently started dating each other again and a proposal is in the works.

videos.title: After Show - Something Blue
videos.overview: Nessa is joined by special guests in the TRL studio to discuss Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: After Show - I'm Beautiful, I'm Smart, I'm Strong
videos.overview: Nessa is joined by special guests in the TRL studio to discuss Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: After Show - Choose Your Path
videos.overview: Nessa is joined by special guests in the TRL studio to discuss Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: After Show - Keep Chugging Away
videos.overview: Nessa and EJ Johnson sit down with Tyler and Brianna to chat about the latest baby mama drama, and check in with Andrew and a very pregnant Amber.

videos.title: After Show - Friends in Need
videos.overview: The women discuss Jade’s argument with Sean, play a game of Most Likely To and face off in a one-handed diaper challenge.

videos.title: After Show - Time Will Tell
videos.overview: Nessa and EJ Johnson chat with Maci and Taylor about their adoption process as well as Ryan's arrest, and Kayla drops by to discuss her argument with Stephan.

videos.title: After Show - One Life to Live
videos.overview: Nessa is joined by special guests in the TRL studio to discuss Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: Reunion – Check-Up with Dr. Drew, Pt. 1
videos.overview: Dr. Drew sits down with Maci, Catelynn, Amber, Farrah and their families for an uncensored discussion about all the biggest moments from this season of Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: Reunion – Check-Up with Dr. Drew, Pt. 2
videos.overview: Cheyenne’s father finds out that her boyfriend Zach lives with her. Maci has an awkward handoff with Ryan’s mom, Jen, while Amber realizes that despite her joy as a new mom, she’s still struggling with depression.

videos.title: Reunion - Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Nessa joins the mothers – and for the first time ever, the fathers – of Teen Mom OG to watch never-before-seen moments from Season 7.

videos.title: Not-So-Happily Ever After
videos.overview: Teen Mom OG looks back at the moms’ search for love over the years, from fizzled flings to devastating heartbreak.

videos.title: All the Times Teen Mom Broke the Internet
videos.overview: Nessa looks back at the cast's most viral moments, including Jenelle's Kesha obsession, Kailyn's unfortunate pregnancy reveal and Briana's plastic surgery live stream.

videos.title: Reunion - Ask the Moms
videos.overview: The moms and grandmas answer fan questions on topics ranging from Farrah’s exit, how they deal with social media judgement and vaginal rejuvenation.

videos.title: Law & Disorder
videos.overview: This special covers the Teen Mom OG cast's numerous brushes with the law, from domestic violence to custody disputes to unseen footage from Ryan's recent drug arrest.

videos.title: Where Are They Now? Mackenzie Mckee
videos.overview: Teen Mom OG's Mackenzie McKee opens up about her battle with postpartum depression, being a mom of three while starting a career and coping with her mother's cancer diagnosis.

videos.title: The New Moms
videos.overview: Two new moms join the show: Cheyenne, who has a complicated co-parenting situation, and Bristol, who juggles raising a family and dealing with her husband’s PTSD.

videos.title: Cheaters
videos.overview: The cast of Teen Mom OG and Teen Mom 2 have faced the consequences of cheating as candid moments of trust issues, rumors and deception are caught on camera.

videos.title: After Show - Welcome to the family
videos.overview: EJ Johnson hosts as Catelynn, Cheyenne and Bristol discuss the season premiere, and Catelynn gets answers when she gives Cheyenne and Bristol an OG interrogation.

videos.title: Reunion, Pt. 1
videos.overview: Maci, Catelynn, Amber, Bristol and Cheyenne sit down with Nessa and Dr. Drew for an uncensored discussion about all the biggest moments from this season of Teen Mom OG.

videos.title: Reunion, Pt. 2
videos.overview: Dr. Drew and Nessa sit down with Amber as she meets Gary's biological father, sort through Bristol and Dakota's divorce, and catch up on Cheyenne and Cory's relationship.

videos.title: Reunion - Unseen Moments
videos.overview: The cast watches unaired moments from the previous season, including Tyler discussing his baby gender preference, Bristol's dental work and Amber's boxing pointers.

videos.title: Reunion - Ask the Moms
videos.overview: The casts of Teen Mom OG and Teen Mom Young + Pregnant reunite onstage to answer the most burning fan questions, dish out behind-the-scenes filming secrets and more.

videos.title: Backstage Pass
videos.overview: Find out what really went down backstage at the reunion, from Amber's explosive confrontation with producers to Bristol and Dakota's new beginning.

videos.title: Mugshot Mayhem
videos.overview: Jenelle, Amber and more Teen Mom fan favorites have navigated serious issues over the years, but even in the darkest times, their kids have inspired them to do better.

videos.title: Maci & Taylor: a Love Story
videos.overview: Maci and Taylor take a walk down memory lane to look back at their journey together, from when they first met to the birth of their children to their wedding day.

videos.title: Being Cory
videos.overview: Even after taking on MTV's The Challenge, Cory Wharton's biggest challenge of all may be fatherhood—and balancing his rising career and ever-changing love life.

videos.title: Being Dakota
videos.overview: War hero and entrepreneur Dakota Meyer navigates the struggles of co-parenting with his ex-wife Bristol while adjusting to being a single dad to his two daughters.

videos.title: Being Levi
videos.overview: Levi Johnston recalls being a teen dad in the public eye, tackles co-parenting with Bristol from across the country and celebrates the gender reveal of his fourth child.

videos.title: Reunion, Pt. 1
videos.overview: Catelynn, Cheyenne, Maci and other special guests join hosts Nessa and Dr. Drew for an emotional look back at all the joy, changes and hardships of an unforgettable season.

videos.title: Reunion, Pt. 2
videos.overview: Ten years after the 16 and Pregnant premiere, Nessa and Dr. Drew sit down with Maci, Cheyenne, Catelynn and Amber to discuss co-parenting, sobriety and mental health.

videos.title: Reunion - Unseen Moments
videos.overview: Nessa sits down with Cheyenne and Cory, Catelynn and Tyler, Maci and Taylor, and Gary and Kristina to watch candid, never-before-seen footage from the show.

videos.title: Reunion Part 1
videos.overview: Catelynn reveals a big surprise and Cheyenne discusses intimate details about her relationship with Zach. Amber and Gary’s co-parenting relationship deteriorates even further while Maci and Taylor’s conversation with Jen takes a dramatic turn.

videos.title: Looking for Love
videos.overview: Single teenage mom Farrah starts dating against her family's wishes while Maci begins planning her wedding to fiancé Ryan. Catelynn moves back home with her disapproving parents and Amber's anxiety about being a mom gets the best of her.

videos.title: How Many Chances?
videos.overview: While teen mom Maci contemplates breaking up with her fiancé, Ryan, Farrah starts dating a new guy even though her family disapproves. Amber struggles to get her GED, and Catelynn feels distant from her daughter since the adoption.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: Catelynn's family lashes out over her choice of adoption while Amber and her fiancé Gary come to blows over their relationship. Farrah learns that dating isn't easy for a teen mom, and newly-single mom Maci struggles to balance motherhood and school when her friends leave for college.

videos.title: Moving On
videos.overview: Amber and Gary's arguing finally reaches a boiling point, while Catelynn struggles to find a home when her mother moves away. Newly-single mom Maci has a change of heart, and boy-crazy Farrah opts for some protection.

videos.title: A Little Help
videos.overview: Catelynn copes with her decision to choose adoption during a weekend retreat with other birth moms, while Maci and Ryan reach out to a counselor for help with their troubled relationship; Newly-single mom Amber thinks about accepting help from her ex, and Farrah starts to wonder if she should stay home more with her baby.

videos.title: Standing Up
videos.overview: Teenage mother Maci struggles with resenting her boyfriend, while Catelynn worries her boyfriend's father might go to jail. Single-mom Farrah shifts her focus to her daughter, and Amber faces her fears about putting her baby in daycare.

videos.title: Baby Steps
videos.overview: Amber wants to put an end to the fighting and move away from Gary, and Farrah can't stand living under her parents' roof anymore. Maci struggles to keep up in school when her son starts walking, and Catelynn and Tyler start to plan their future.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler work on letting go of Carly, and Tyler works up the nerve to propose marriage to Catelynn. Maci and Ryan struggle with their relationship while celebrating Bentley's first birthday. Amber copes with the pressures of being a single mom while planning Leah's first birthday, and Farrah makes peace with her own mother.

videos.title: Not Again
videos.overview: Farrah calls the police on her own mother after they get in a big fight, while Amber faces a pregnancy scare that could prevent her from ever finishing high school. Maci takes her ex, Ryan, to court for child support, and Catelynn is upset to find out she has to move out of boyfriend Tyler's house and back in with her unpredictable family, an hour away from their high school.

videos.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go?
videos.overview: Catelynn gets caught in a lie and faces losing her boyfriend Tyler, while Amber's boyfriend Gary tells her he might leave her for another girl. Farrah juggles college, a new job, and moving out of her parents' house to live on her own for the first time -- all with her daughter Sophia. Maci tries to move into a shared house with her college friends, but realizes that having a baby might get in the way.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: Single mom Maci goes clubbing with her girlfriends for Valentine's Day and reconnects with an old flame, while a crying baby and unrealistic expectations ruin Amber & Gary's romantic dinner. Catelynn's fiancé Tyler struggles with guilt about the adoption when he tries to go out and have fun like a normal teenager, while Farrah reveals an emotional secret about her baby's dad.

videos.title: Spring Break
videos.overview: Amber and Gary take a vacation and discover there's no such thing as spring break once you have a baby. Maci butts heads with Ryan over his new girlfriend, and realizes how hard it is to parent together after you break up. Farrah's mom is offered a plea bargain for their physical altercation, and they have an emotional encounter, while Catelynn finds out Tyler is still angry at her about a past lie.

videos.title: Secrets & Lies
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler find their high school romance back on the rocks when Catelynn reveals another lie, and it ruins a visit to their adoption agent. Gary dresses up as a bunny for Leah on Easter, but a big fight makes Amber question their engagement. Maci's new boyfriend meets her son Bentley for the first time, and Farrah falls victim to a scam.

videos.title: Trial and Error
videos.overview: Maci questions whether her boyfriend Kyle is ready to date a teen mom and be a real part of her son's life, while Farrah tries speed dating. Amber works toward her GED until she realizes that finishing high school with a baby is harder than she expected. Catelynn's step-dad Butch is court-ordered to rehab, leaving her alone with her mom who makes her feel guilty about the adoption.

videos.title: Senior Prom
videos.overview: An argument about the adoption ruins Catelynn's day shopping for prom dresses with her mom, but she and Tyler get a nice surprise at prom; Maci is heartbroken when Ryan announces he's taking her to court over custody of Bentley. Farrah goes to counseling with her mom, and Amber's fun birthday plans are ruined when Gary refuses to babysit.

videos.title: Hello and Goodbye
videos.overview: Amber and Gary's wedding plans fall apart over an argument about how to raise Leah, while Farrah considers moving back into her mother's house. Catelynn and Tyler celebrate their daughter Carly's first birthday from afar by calling her to say hello, and Maci finally tells her parents she's moving two hours away with Bentley, and they aren't happy.

videos.title: Family Bonds
videos.overview: Farrah reaches out to Sophia's dad's family in an attempt to get Social Security benefits for Sophia. Maci tells Ryan she is moving to Nashville, while Catelynn and Tyler learn Butch has ended up back in jail. Gary asks Amber if he can stay at her place until he finds a place of his own.

videos.title: Lashing Out
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler find out they will not graduate from High School on time, while Maci tries to work out a visitation schedule with Ryan in spite of being angry about their last encounter. Farrah has an emotional reunion with Sophia's dad's sister for the first time since he died, and Amber lashes out at Gary when he calls her a bad mom and threatens to take Leah away.

videos.title: Too Much Too Soon
videos.overview: Maci confronts Kyle when she realizes her new life in Nashville isn't what she expected, while Catelynn and Tyler learn they will get to go visit Carly for the first time in a year. Amber breaks it off with Gary for good and starts dating a new guy, and Farrah learns the results of Sophia's DNA test.

videos.title: See You Later
videos.overview: A year after the adoption, Catelynn and Tyler have an emotional reunion with their daughter Carly. Amber & Gary try to work out custody of Leah now that they are broken up and dating other people. Farrah's mom sets her up on a date with a new guy, and Maci & Ryan battle over parental rights once and for all.

videos.title: Taking It Slow
videos.overview: Maci confronts her ex, Ryan, about missing child support payments - and he lashes back at her new boyfriend. Amber has to choose between her baby's dad and her new boyfriend. Catelynn and Tyler consider moving in together while still in high school, and single mom Farrah considers making a big change.

videos.title: To Be with You
videos.overview: Amber and Gary move in together and a fun family weekend turns sour, while Tyler's family questions his decision to move in with Catelynn. Maci considers letting her boyfriend Kyle live with her and Bentley to make ends meet - and Farrah struggles with being away from Sophia for a weekend modeling job.

videos.title: The Last Straw
videos.overview: Amber finds out she is being investigated by the police, and fears she will lose custody of Leah. Ryan wants to meet Maci's new boyfriend Kyle, while Farrah finds out Sophia's paternal grandmother is suing for visitation rights. Tyler's dad Butch gets out of jail and re-unites with the family.

videos.title: Trials and Tribulations
videos.overview: Catelynn struggles to fix her relationship with her mom, while Amber & Gary meet with Child Protective Services. Maci finally decides to move away from Kyle and back home to Chattanooga, and Farrah goes to court.

videos.title: Trick or Treat
videos.overview: Maci and Ryan argue over who has rights to Bentley on his birthday, and Amber breaks down over being separated from Leah on Halloween. Farrah struggles to spend time with Sophia while finishing her last remaining school credits, and Catelynn and Tyler look for jobs.

videos.title: Terrible Twos
videos.overview: Amber is upset when Gary refuses to celebrate Leah's birthday together as a family, and Catelynn goes on a weekend retreat to cope with her fears about the adoption. Farrah celebrates finishing college by getting a puppy for her daughter Sophia, and hiding it from her mom, while Maci's Ex, Ryan, finally discovers that her boyfriend Kyle is living with her.

videos.title: Without You
videos.overview: Farrah and Sophia visit Sophia's father's grave; Amber and her mother argue; Maci struggles to keep up; Catelynn and Tyler want to invite their daughter to graduation.

videos.title: Taking It Up a Notch
videos.overview: Amber goes on a date with a new guy, while Catelynn and Tyler get their parents involved with planning a perfect Christmas for Carly. Maci makes a shocking announcement, and Farrah breaks the news to her parents she wants to move to California.

videos.title: As Long as We're Together
videos.overview: Farrah and her parents take a trip to Arizona - but end up arguing the whole time, and Catelynn reunites with her father for the first time since the adoption. Amber reaches out to Gary to re-unite her family on the emotional anniversary of a tragedy, while Maci considers withdrawing from school.

videos.title: Stay With Me
videos.overview: Amber gets arrested and spends the night in jail, only to find out a no-contact order has been put on her and Gary. Catelynn & Tyler have a falling out, and Farrah takes Sophia to explore moving to Florida. When Kyle is injured, Maci is overwhelmed taking care of Bentley, Kyle, and school.

videos.title: Time Out
videos.overview: Maci has a blowout with Ryan over custody of their son Bentley, while Amber & Gary struggle with raising Leah together with a no-contact order in place. Catelynn finally finishes high school and takes Tyler out of town to celebrate, and Farrah's parents try to talk her into leaving Sophia behind when she moves away.

videos.title: Pros and Cons
videos.overview: Amber & Gary try to get the no contact order lifted so they can raise Leah together as a family. Maci tries to cut Ryan out of her life, and Ryan makes a decision about taking Maci to court. Farrah makes an unexpected choice about moving away, and Butch moves in with Catelynn & Tyler, who make a hard decision about Carly.

videos.title: Separation Anxiety
videos.overview: Maci decides to enroll Bentley in daycare while Amber prepares to go to rehab. Catelynn and Tyler Celebrate Carly's second birthday, and Farrah has change of heart about leaving daughter Sophia behind when she moves.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler have an emotional second year visit with their daughter Carly. Amber struggles with missing her daughter Leah during her first weeks of rehab as Farrah says farewell to her life in Iowa. A disagreement with Ryan disrupts Maci & Kyle's relationship.

videos.title: The Places You'll Go
videos.overview: Catelynn and Tyler attend their high school graduation while Maci thinks about joining Ryan on his family vacation. Farrah begins setting into her new home only to have to deal with her parents' overbearing concerns. Amber learns that Gary and Leah are planning to visit her in rehab.

videos.title: Strike Out
videos.overview: Gary and Leah visit Amber in rehab and Farrah goes on a date with her neighbor. Maci tags along on Ryan's family vacation, and meets Ryan's new girlfriend, Dalis. And Catelynn and Tyler question letting Butch move back into their home.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Amber and Gary work on their relationship issues and Maci struggles to make choices about her college classes. Farrah visits her parents only to become annoyed with their concerns for Sophia. Catelynn and her grandmother attend a birth parent support group.

videos.title: Temper Tantrums
videos.overview: A visit from Farrah's mom and sister leads to a blowup, and Maci enrolls her son Bentley in preschool. Catelynn and Tyler face issues with Butch, while Amber debates leaving rehab early.

videos.title: Fresh Start
videos.overview: Maci and Ryan clash over Bentley attending preschool. Tyler pressures Catelynn to enroll in college while Farrah begins dating a new guy. After completing two months in rehab, Amber finally heads back home.

videos.title: The Next Step
videos.overview: Maci and Kyle contemplate buying a house togther and Farrah introduces Sophia to her new boyfriend. Now that she's home Amber struggles to find a way to see her daughter Leah. A fight between Catelynn and Tyler's parents throw thier family's future into question.

videos.title: By the Rules
videos.overview: Maci and Taylor work on their marriage in counseling while Farrah goes on a date with Assaf, whom she picked on last week's aftershow.  Gary asks Amber to help him surprise Leah with a new house.

videos.title: Change of Plans
videos.overview: Farrah and Daniel talk about their future while paddle-boating together on their Texas vacation. Farrah begins to ask about Daniel's thoughts on marriage and

videos.title: For the Best
videos.overview: Maci and Ryan fight over Bentley's birthday. Farrah spends time with Sophia before leaving for a month. Amber and Gary agree on a custody plan for Leah. Catelynn and Tyler help their parents deal with their issues.

videos.title: Wake Up
videos.overview: Ryan confronts Maci about their custody arrangment. Amber has second thoughts giving Gary full custody of Leah. Farrah misses Sophia. Catelynn and Tyler reflect on the adoption. A tribute to the four original moms depicting their journey through both 16 & Pregnant and Teen Mom

videos.title: Back and Better Than Ever
videos.overview: Cate and Tyler find out they are pregnant so Cate wants to get married. Maci struggles co-parenting with Ryan. Amber falls for Gary’s flirting, but is crushed when he goes on a family vacation with his new girlfriend and Leah.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: Cate and Tyler plan a party to reveal the gender of their baby. Maci struggles with the fact that Bentley is starting kindergarten. Gary invites Amber to be a part of Leah's first day of kindergarten.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Tyler posts a video of Carly on their fan page which upsets Brandon and Teresa. Maci continues struggling to communicate with Ryan about co-parenting. Amber is extremely hurt by Gary because he won’t let Leah spend the night.

videos.title: New Kids on the Block
